description: Removes the passcode or invite-only setting from a whole site (path "/", the default) or the protection from one path, so anyone can view it again (owner; an AI gets approve_url for the owner's approval). A protected path stays protected until it is opened by its own path.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: re-call with it for the approval status

path.description: "/" (default, whole site) or a protected part such as /students

name: unprotect
title: Remove protection
